title: AID P065 — C0 Codex PLAN Review Raw Response
$comment: producer: Codex CLI (a DIFFERENT-provider process, `_run_codex_isolated` — the SAME transport C3 uses, extracted by P065 E-065-7_7 Step 18), consumer: aid-c0-plan-review.sh `dispatch`/`verify`. This is the RAW last-message Codex emits for a PLAN review (BEFORE plan/EPIC-generation), NOT a finished-implementation audit. It is intentionally a DIFFERENT shape from c3-codex-response.schema.json: the C0 response is self-describing (`artifact_type` is a REQUIRED, model-emitted, const-pinned field) so a model that mistakenly answers with a C3-shaped `audit_report` payload (reviewed_head/codex_brief_hash/no artifact_type) is REJECTED by this schema's required-key list and additionalProperties:false, never silently accepted as a plan review. codex `session_id`/`model`/provenance are added by the bridge during normalize — they are FORBIDDEN here, exactly like C3's forbidden top-level provenance keys, and for the same reason: the model must never self-assert its own provenance.

artifact_type.$comment: REQUIRED, model-emitted, and pinned to this exact value — NOT 'audit_report'. This is the mechanical fence that makes a C3-shaped response invalid_output under this schema (audit_report responses never carry this key).

reviewed_plan_hash.$comment: verbatim echo of the sealed brief's plan_sha256 (= build-manifest's reviewed_plan_hash for the plan file under review).

reviewed_head.$comment: the commit Codex reviewed the repository at; MUST equal the brief's reviewed_head (40-hex git sha).

input_manifest_hash.$comment: verbatim echo of the sealed brief's input_manifest_hash. Distinct from C3's codex_brief_hash concept — C0 has no separate 'brief' bundle; the input manifest IS what is sealed and echoed.

unverifiable_reasons.$comment: how the model reports 'could not complete the plan review' without inventing a field; conditionally required (see allOf).

blocking_findings.$comment: Codex asserts this; the bridge cross-checks blocking_findings == (∃ crit/high finding) in jq — JSON-Schema cannot express that cross-field arithmetic.

allOf.$comment: action_owner is REQUIRED when severity is critical or high; optional (but still enum-constrained) otherwise. Fingerprint/occurrence_id are NOT here — those are bridge-added during normalize, exactly like C3's findings[], never emitted by the model itself.
pass ⇒ no findings AND blocking_findings must be false.
